stem: An automation change was made at 10:00. At 10:12 a sensor begins oscillating, but a verified independent logger remains stable and equipment commands begin cycling rapidly. What is the strongest escalation package?
choices: Timeline of the control change, both data streams, command cycling, affected equipment and crop scope, and the last known-good state
A statement that the sensor is broken
A request to disable all alarms
rationale: The strongest evidence package preserves timing, independent measurements, control behavior, affected scope, and the last known-good state without prematurely assigning root cause.
